name: Yeast 1
shortDescription: Subtle ester qualities, highlighting hop characters. Ferments out clear.
longDescription:
An excellent American Ale style yeast of some pedigree, Y1 can throw subtle esters, complementing the malt backbone whilst highlighting the hop characters of your brew. Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 21°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 15-22°C

name: Yeast 2
shortDescription: Fruity and ester flavours that blend well with heavily bittered beers. Slight cloudiness.
longDescription:
Y2 tends to produce fruity flavours and esters. Finishing at a slightly higher specific gravity, the resulting residual sweetness can work nicely with heavily bittered ales. Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 21°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 18-22°C

name: Yeast 3
shortDescription: A neutral yet vigorous fermenting strain. Ferments out clear.
longDescription:
A quite neutral, yet vigorous fermenting strain, Y3 is enormously popular and extremely versatile. For use across a large range of ale styles and may even be fermented at lager temperatures. Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 19°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 18-22°C

name: Yeast 4
shortDescription: Clean malt and hop aromas. Produces well attenuated clear ales.
longDescription:
A proprietary strain belonging to Coopers Brewery, Y4 ferments vigorously, producing a well attenuated ale with clean malt and hop aromas. Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 19°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 18-20°C

name: Yeast 5
shortDescription: Subtle banana and clove qualities complementing wheat beers. Finish is slightly cloudy.
longDescription:
A versatile wheat yeast, Y5 can throw both banana and clove characters at various levels, dependent on fermentation temperature and pitching rates. Great for all wheat beers! Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 21°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 18-22°C

name: Yeast 6
shortDescription: Phenolic, peppery characters with hints of banana. Finish is slightly cloudy.
longDescription:
A Belgian Ale style yeast, Y6 happily ferments higher alcohol brews, typical of the Trappist styles, whilst producing phenolic flavours and aromas redolent of the region. Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 21°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 20-22°C

name: Yeast 7
shortDescription: Clean aromas and flavours. Finished beer is clear.
longDescription:
An extremely popular strain used for a broad spectrum of lager styles. Works happily at lager fermentation temperatures to produce clean aromas and flavours, that emphasise the malt and hop characters of the beer. This strain will also cope with slightly warmer fermentation temperatures, for the Californian Common style. Ingredients: Brewing YeastNet Weight: 10g Program: Lager
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 22°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 12-15°C

name: Yeast 8
shortDescription: A versatile strain with neutral flavours. Ferments out clear.
longDescription:
A versatile strain with neutral flavour development, Y8 emphasises a brew's malt characters. Prefers lager fermentation temperatures, suitable for various lagers but particularly suited to the pilsner style. Ingredients: Brewing YeastNet Weight: 10g Program: Lager
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 22°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 12-15°C

name: Yeast 9
shortDescription: Subtle fruity and estery characters. Ferments out clear.
longDescription:
Y9 is a widely used lager strain, which may produce subtle fruity and estery characters to compliment the brew's malt/hop profile. Tends to finish at a slightly higher specific gravity giving increased mouth-feel and length to the palate. Suitable for most styles of lager. Ingredients: Brewing YeastNet Weight: 10g Program: Lager
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 22°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 12-15°C

name: Yeast 10
shortDescription: Soft fruity esters for hazy, hop-forward beers. Fuller mouthfeel with gentle haze.
longDescription:
Suited to hazy and hop-forward styles, Y10 produces soft stone-fruit esters with light tropical and citrus notes that blend smoothly with hop additions. With medium-high attenuation, it leaves a fuller body and soft, rounded finish. Ingredients: Brewing Yeast
Net Weight: 10g Program: Ale
Or if using Custom Program:
Recommended Propagate Temperature: 20°C
Recommended Ferment Temperature: 18-25°C
